title: Queued-send burst offline performance readiness
purpose: Satisfy REQ-QUIC-CRT-0253 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0258 with an exact two-cell queued-send authority, deterministic eight-block timing campaign, package-backed ProtocolLab execution, a preflight stream-throughput gate, resumable bounded evidence, and a non-accepting descriptive result.
design_summary: The implemented design reuses the existing queued-send correctness and actuation boundary, but narrows performance authority to exactly two cells and one exact manifest-bound measurement bundle. The compiler emits an eight-block, two-position alternating order so each queued-send treatment appears four times in each position and the resulting 16 jobs remain reproducible. The ProtocolLab runner owns package-backed execution, exact artifact selection, bounded cumulative-epoch reconciliation, and resumability. A separate preflight proved predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one before any timed row was accepted. The canonical analysis preserves block and position effects and bounded aggregate observations, but does not promote a policy winner or derive a new adaptive rule.
data_and_state_considerations: Control documents are immutable, versioned, content-hashed, replayable, and additive. The completed campaign binds source commit 5bd4b4d2ddbb027bee534392dca2a2518f8fa935, control hash cb80a3309d792443e903657746c2be0a7931a838f1bf37eba4b84ff727bcc382, manifest hash 2ad809ecdb882f000c38d00c97f69604cbb3e004186535fd2348800e7c8a27ab, exact package binaries, the independent plab-worker-x64-02 and plab-worker-x64-03 pair, workload quic.transport.stream-download.1mb, block, position, cell, job, run, runtime evidence, and checksums. Failed or retried attempts remain retained evidence. The separate activation preflight proved the legal-budget predicate, while the canonical result hash 1c02b545e1714079fc12f6f46bba502c5f5c661dbf5883a2591774cbfe9979 preserves only bounded reconciled aggregates in the repository.
edge_cases_and_constraints: All adjacent queued-send axes remain legacy_current and must not vary during this slice.
A failed gate proof for quic.transport.stream-download.1mb must leave single_datagram rows unaccepted.
Resumed jobs must preserve the original exact identity, not mint a fresh logical cell.
Bounded aggregate evidence must not delete failed or retried attempts.
A two-cell family does not justify covering-array generation.
alternatives_considered: Fold the queued-send timing work into the admission-performance slice; rejected because the queued-send gate and exact treatment pair are behaviorally distinct and already have their own correctness lineage.
Use a covering-array campaign; rejected because the family has only two cells.
Authorize timing rows without the stream-throughput gate; rejected because the single_datagram cell must prove predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one before the row is accepted.
risks: A stale manifest hash could misbind the exact measurement authority.
A package/runtime mismatch could make resumable timing evidence look credible when it is not.
The gate workload could be overread as acceptance evidence if the timing result is not kept descriptively bounded.
A non-deterministic block order would defeat the intended two-position characterization.
